Name: Terran Corridor
Details: Terran Corridor is a term applied to the worlds linking a Successor State or other power to humanity's homeworld of Terra. Originally part of the Terran Hegemony, that nation's fall after the Amaris Civil War left these systems under the control of the Great Houses. Each Successor State's Terran Corridor became a battleground during the First Succession War, as the House militaries fought to secure former Hegemony worlds.
